audience: Austrian shops and businesses that run a KASSA.AT cash register

useCases.title: Look up articles with prices and VAT
useCases.text: Search the articles by text, article number or bar code. Each article shows its price, VAT percent and unit. Then list the categories an article belongs to.

useCases.title: Find a customer by customer number
useCases.text: Find one customer by the number you assigned, or search all customers with a text query.

useCases.title: Check the stock of an article in a warehouse
useCases.text: List the warehouses, then read the current stock of an article in one of them. Inventory lookups are rate limited by KASSA.AT.

useCases.title: Add received goods to stock
useCases.text: Find the inventory record of an article in a warehouse, then record a stock movement. A positive quantity adds stock and a negative one removes it.

useCases.title: Create or update articles and customers
useCases.text: Create an article with a VAT percent of 0, 10, 13 or 20, or change fields of an article or customer. Nothing is deleted.
